documents.title: SQL Injection — Prevention Cheat Sheet
documents.summary: Use parameterized queries 100% of the time. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings. Prefer ORM with safe defaults.
documents.remediation_pattern: Replace string concatenation with parameterized query or ORM method.
references: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet

documents.title: XSS Prevention — Output Encoding
documents.summary: Contextual output encoding prevents XSS. Use framework auto-escaping where available. Sanitize with DOMPurify for client-side.
documents.remediation_pattern: Apply context-aware output encoding (HTML, JS, URL, CSS contexts).

documents.title: Insecure Deserialization
documents.summary: Deserializing untrusted data leads to RCE. Use safe serializers (JSON) or type-whitelisting.
documents.remediation_pattern: Replace native deserialization with JSON schema validation or type-whitelisted deserialization.

documents.title: OS Command Injection
documents.summary: Never pass user input to shell/command execution. Use library APIs instead of subprocess. Escape if unavoidable.
documents.remediation_pattern: Replace os.system/subprocess with library-native equivalents. If shell is required, use shlex.quote() and whitelist allowed commands.

documents.title: Weak Cryptography — Use Strong Algorithms
documents.summary: MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4 are broken. Use AES-256-GCM, SHA-256+, ECDSA/Ed25519.
documents.remediation_pattern: Replace broken algorithm with AES-256-GCM (encryption) or SHA-256+ (hashing).

documents.title: Hardcoded Credentials
documents.summary: Credentials in source code are leaked on commit. Use AWS Secrets Manager, env vars, or vault.
documents.remediation_pattern: Remove hardcoded credential and replace with Secrets Manager lookup or environment variable.

documents.title: Missing Authorization / Missing Authentication
documents.summary: Every endpoint that accesses sensitive data or performs privileged actions must verify authorization.
documents.remediation_pattern: Add authorization check at every entrypoint. Use middleware/decorators to enforce globally.

documents.title: Use-After-Free — Memory Safety
documents.summary: Accessing freed memory can lead to code execution or information disclosure. Critical in C/C++.
documents.remediation_pattern: Set pointers to NULL after free. Use smart pointers in C++. Consider memory-safe languages.

documents.title: Race Conditions / TOCTOU
documents.summary: Concurrent access to shared state can cause data corruption or security bypass. Critical in financial systems.
documents.remediation_pattern: Use locks, atomic operations, or database transactions with SERIALIZABLE isolation.

documents.title: Information Exposure / Sensitive Data in Logs
documents.summary: Logging PAN, PII, credentials, or session tokens violates PCI DSS and LGPD.
documents.remediation_pattern: Apply log redaction/masking. Never log request bodies containing sensitive fields. PCI: never log PAN, CVV, track data.
